title: Crystallization control and defect reduction for superior corrosion resistance of zinc anodes in aqueous zinc-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02109J, Paper
Jingjing Jiang, Sanlue Hu, Tianshuo Guo, Xiangyong Zhang, Hua Wei, Baohui Ren, Ruijia Liu, Guangming Chen, Zhuoxin Liu, Cuiping Han
Under high Ar pressure condition, the recrystallization strategy restructures the texture of the zinc foil, eliminating internal defects and yielding an ultra-corrosion-resistant zinc anode for high-safety zinc batteries.
